“Love Pocket” - Lords and Liars (Official Music Video)
Step into a 1920s speakeasy where a ringmaster frontman runs the room, and nobody leaves the same. Filmed in a real abandoned building with no power and no plumbing.
ABOUT THE VIDEO
Welcome to the underbelly of the 1920s: a dimly lit speakeasy pulsing with grit, energy, and something a little unhinged. “Love Pocket” drops you straight into that world as an eccentric band takes the stage.
